description: Lovejoin: A Cardano-native, non-custodial privacy mixer

contracts.name: Mix Box
contracts.description: This contract holds the pooled mix boxes and defers validation to the mix logic.

contracts.name: Mix Logic
contracts.description: This contract verifies the mix and withdraw proofs once per transaction.

contracts.name: Fee Pool
contracts.description: This contract holds the shared fee shards that pay for mix transactions.

contracts.name: Reference Minter
contracts.description: This contract mints the one-of-one Lovejoin reference token.

contracts.name: Reference Holder
contracts.description: This contract permanently holds the reference token and protocol parameters.
